transforms.code:
# ---- Master/Supplier combined grid builder — inline runPrepQuery (Order-spike pattern) ----
	# Reused verbatim from the List view's gridModel transform. Executes the canonical
	# Supplier/list SQL from master-crud-namedqueries.sql via system.db.runPrepQuery.
	# IG81-COMPAT: plain parameterized T-SQL; runs identically on 8.1.52 and 8.3.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	parts = unicode(value).split("|")
	searchTerm = parts[0]
	siteId = int(float(parts[1]))   # IG-SITE: plumbed through view->query; predicate still commented (D1)

	sql = ("SELECT  s.IN_SUPPLIER_ID        AS RecordID, "
	       "        s.VC_SUPPLIER_CODE      AS SupplierCode, "
	       "        s.VC_SUPPLIER_NAME      AS SupplierName, "
	       "        s.VC_CITY               AS City, "
	       "        s.VC_STATE              AS State, "
	       "        l.VC_LOGISTICS_NAME     AS Logistics, "
	       "        CASE s.VC_OUTPUT_FILE WHEN 'T' THEN 'TEXT' WHEN 'E' THEN 'EXCEL' WHEN 'B' THEN 'BOTH' END AS OutputFileType, "
	       "        CASE s.VC_INVENTORY_ADD_POINT WHEN 'S' THEN 'SHIPPED' WHEN 'A' THEN 'ARRIVED' END AS InventoryAddPoint "
	       "FROM    INV_SUPPLIER_MST s "
	       "        LEFT OUTER JOIN INV_LOGISTICS_MST l ON s.IN_LOGISTICS_ID = l.IN_LOGISTICS_ID "
	       "WHERE  (? = '' OR s.VC_SUPPLIER_CODE LIKE '%' + ? + '%' OR s.VC_SUPPLIER_NAME LIKE '%' + ? + '%') "
	       "-- IG-SITE:  AND s.site_id = ? "
	       "ORDER BY s.VC_SUPPLIER_CODE")
	ds = system.db.runPrepQuery(sql, [searchTerm, searchTerm, searchTerm], DB)
	log.info("SPIKE Supplier/list: %d rows (search='%s' site=%d)" % (ds.rowCount, searchTerm, siteId))

	columns = [
		{"field": "SupplierCode",      "header": {"title": "Supplier Code"},       "strictWidth": 120},
		{"field": "SupplierName",      "header": {"title": "Supplier Name"}},
		{"field": "City",              "header": {"title": "City"}},
		{"field": "State",             "header": {"title": "State"}},
		{"field": "Logistics",         "header": {"title": "Logistics"}},
		{"field": "OutputFileType",    "header": {"title": "Output File Type"}, "strictWidth": 130},
		{"field": "InventoryAddPoint", "header": {"title": "Inventory Add Point"}, "strictWidth": 150},
		{"field": "RecordID",          "header": {"title": "id"}, "visible": False}
	]
	rows = []
	for r in xrange(ds.rowCount):
		rows.append({
			"RecordID":          ds.getValueAt(r, "RecordID"),
			"SupplierCode":      ds.getValueAt(r, "SupplierCode"),
			"SupplierName":      ds.getValueAt(r, "SupplierName"),
			"City":              ds.getValueAt(r, "City"),
			"State":             ds.getValueAt(r, "State"),
			"Logistics":         ds.getValueAt(r, "Logistics"),
			"OutputFileType":    ds.getValueAt(r, "OutputFileType"),
			"InventoryAddPoint": ds.getValueAt(r, "InventoryAddPoint")
		})
	return {"data": rows, "columns": columns}

onChange.script:
# ---- Supplier combined view: recordId change -> load detail (reused from Detail view) ----
	# David's single-view decision: the grid onRowClick sets self.view.custom.recordId =
	# event.value["RecordID"] (a same-view prop write, NO navigation). This onChange fires
	# on that write and populates the in-view form. recordId==0 -> insert mode.
	# IG81-COMPAT: plain change script + T-SQL, identical on 8.1.52 and 8.3.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	v = self.view if hasattr(self, "view") else self
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	c = v.custom
	cv = getattr(currentValue, "value", currentValue)
	recId = int(cv or 0)
	log.info("SPIKE Supplier Detail recordId onChange fired: recId=%s origin=%s" % (recId, origin))
	siteId = int(c.siteId or 1)   # IG-SITE: plumbed; predicate commented (D1)

	# ---- FK combo options (lookups/logistics, lookups/partType) ----
	logDs = system.db.runPrepQuery("SELECT IN_LOGISTICS_ID AS id, VC_LOGISTICS_NAME AS label FROM INV_LOGISTICS_MST /* IG-SITE: WHERE site_id = ? */ ORDER BY VC_LOGISTICS_NAME", [], DB)
	c.logisticsOptions = [{"value": logDs.getValueAt(i, "id"), "label": logDs.getValueAt(i, "label")} for i in xrange(logDs.rowCount)]
	ptDs = system.db.runPrepQuery("SELECT VC_PART_TYPE AS id, VC_PART_TYPE AS label FROM INV_PART_TYPE_MST /* IG-SITE: WHERE site_id = ? */ ORDER BY VC_PART_TYPE", [], DB)
	c.partTypeOptions = [{"value": ptDs.getValueAt(i, "id"), "label": ptDs.getValueAt(i, "label")} for i in xrange(ptDs.rowCount)]
	log.info("SPIKE Supplier Detail combos: logistics=%d partType=%d" % (logDs.rowCount, ptDs.rowCount))

	if recId <= 0:
		c.statusMsg = "New supplier — enter details and Save."
		log.info("SPIKE Supplier Detail: insert mode (recordId=0)")
		return

	# ---- edit mode: Supplier/get ----
	getSql = ("SELECT s.VC_SUPPLIER_CODE, s.VC_SUPPLIER_NAME, s.VC_ADDRESS, s.VC_CITY, s.VC_STATE, "
	          "s.VC_ZIP, s.VC_COUNTRY, s.VC_TEL, s.VC_FAX, s.VC_PERSON, s.VC_EMAIL_ADDRESS, "
	          "s.VC_BREAKDOWN_ORDER_DIRECTORY, s.IN_LOGISTICS_ID, l.VC_LOGISTICS_NAME, "
	          "s.VC_OUTPUT_FILE, s.BIT_ORDER_FILE_TIMESTAMP, s.BIT_SITE_NUMBER_IN_ORDER, "
	          "s.VC_CREATE_ORDER_SHEET, s.VC_INVENTORY_ADD_POINT "
	          "FROM INV_SUPPLIER_MST s LEFT OUTER JOIN INV_LOGISTICS_MST l ON s.IN_LOGISTICS_ID = l.IN_LOGISTICS_ID "
	          "WHERE s.IN_SUPPLIER_ID = ? -- IG-SITE: AND s.site_id = ?")
	ds = system.db.runPrepQuery(getSql, [recId], DB)
	if ds.rowCount == 0:
		c.statusMsg = "Supplier id %d not found." % recId
		log.warn("SPIKE Supplier Detail: id %d not found" % recId); return
	def g(col):
		val = ds.getValueAt(0, col)
		return val if val is not None else ""
	c.form_code = g("VC_SUPPLIER_CODE"); c.form_name = g("VC_SUPPLIER_NAME")
	c.form_address = g("VC_ADDRESS"); c.form_city = g("VC_CITY"); c.form_state = g("VC_STATE")
	c.form_zip = g("VC_ZIP"); c.form_country = g("VC_COUNTRY"); c.form_tel = g("VC_TEL")
	c.form_fax = g("VC_FAX"); c.form_person = g("VC_PERSON"); c.form_email = g("VC_EMAIL_ADDRESS")
	c.form_directory = g("VC_BREAKDOWN_ORDER_DIRECTORY")
	lid = ds.getValueAt(0, "IN_LOGISTICS_ID")
	c.form_logisticsId = int(lid) if lid is not None else None
	c.form_outputFile = g("VC_OUTPUT_FILE") or "T"
	c.form_orderFileTimestamp = bool(ds.getValueAt(0, "BIT_ORDER_FILE_TIMESTAMP"))
	c.form_siteNumberInOrder = bool(ds.getValueAt(0, "BIT_SITE_NUMBER_IN_ORDER"))
	c.form_createOrderSheet = g("VC_CREATE_ORDER_SHEET")
	c.form_invAddPoint = g("VC_INVENTORY_ADD_POINT") or "S"
	c.statusMsg = "Editing supplier %s (id %d)." % (c.form_code, recId)
	log.info("SPIKE Supplier Detail loaded id=%d code=%s logId=%s" % (recId, c.form_code, c.form_logisticsId))

config.script:
# Re-run Supplier/list. Bumping runNonce changes the gridModel expression input.
	self.view.custom.runNonce = (self.view.custom.runNonce or 0) + 1
	system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").info("Supplier search -> runNonce=" + str(self.view.custom.runNonce))

# New record: same-view prop write (NO navigation). Setting recordId=0 fires the
	# custom.recordId onChange -> insert-mode (combos load, form left at seed). If it was
	# already 0 we still clear the form so a stale edit doesn't linger.
	c = self.view.custom
	c.form_code = ""; c.form_name = ""; c.form_address = ""; c.form_city = ""; c.form_state = ""
	c.form_zip = ""; c.form_country = ""; c.form_tel = ""; c.form_fax = ""; c.form_person = ""
	c.form_email = ""; c.form_directory = ""; c.form_logisticsId = None
	c.form_outputFile = "T"; c.form_orderFileTimestamp = False; c.form_siteNumberInOrder = False
	c.form_createOrderSheet = ""; c.form_invAddPoint = "S"
	c.recordId = 0
	c.statusMsg = "New supplier — enter details and Save."
	system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").info("SPIKE Supplier New -> recordId=0 (insert mode)")

# Row select -> SAME-VIEW prop write (David's single-view decision; NO navigation).
	# event.value is the row data in IA 8.1. Set custom.recordId, which fires the
	# custom.recordId onChange load script that populates the in-view form (D2:
	# RecordID is IN_SUPPLIER_ID, never the business code).
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	try:
		recId = event.value["RecordID"]
	except Exception:
		recId = event.value["RecordID"] if hasattr(event, "value") else None
	if recId is None:
		log.warn("SPIKE Supplier list row click: no RecordID in event")
		return
	log.info("SPIKE Supplier list -> open Detail recordId=%s" % recId)
	self.view.custom.recordId = int(recId)

props.text: Click a row to edit in the panel at right. Server-side LIKE search on code+name. Single combined view — row-select is an in-view prop write, no navigation. Site param plumbed; IG-SITE predicate commented until the Postgres phase.

config.script:
# ---- Supplier Save (insert-or-update) — §B.3/B.4 (reused from Detail view) ----
	# recordId==0 -> insert; >0 -> update. On success: flip recordId to the saved id
	# (edit mode) and refresh the grid by bumping runNonce (same-view, no navigation).
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	c = self.view.custom
	recId = int(c.recordId or 0)
	siteId = int(c.siteId or 1)   # IG-SITE: plumbed; predicate commented (D1)

	code = (c.form_code or "").strip()
	name = (c.form_name or "").strip()
	invAdd = (c.form_invAddPoint or "").strip()

	# ---- B.4 validation (client-side fast-fail; DB unique index is the backstop) ----
	if len(code) != 5:
		c.statusMsg = "Supplier code must be exactly 5 characters."
		log.info("SPIKE Supplier save REJECTED: code len=%d" % len(code)); return
	if name == "":
		c.statusMsg = "Supplier name is required."
		log.info("SPIKE Supplier save REJECTED: blank name"); return
	if invAdd not in ("S", "A"):
		c.statusMsg = "Inventory Add Point is required (S or A)."
		log.info("SPIKE Supplier save REJECTED: invAddPoint=%r" % invAdd); return

	excludeId = recId if recId > 0 else 0
	chkSql = ("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM INV_SUPPLIER_MST "
	          "WHERE VC_SUPPLIER_CODE = ? AND IN_SUPPLIER_ID <> ? "
	          "-- IG-SITE: AND site_id = ?")
	dup = system.db.runPrepQuery(chkSql, [code, excludeId], DB)
	if dup.rowCount > 0 and int(dup.getValueAt(0, 0)) > 0:
		c.statusMsg = "Supplier code already exists."
		log.info("SPIKE Supplier save REJECTED: dup code=%s" % code); return

	def s(v):
		return (v if v is not None else "")
	logId = c.form_logisticsId
	if logId in (None, "", 0):
		logId = None   # blank Logistics -> NULL (legacy behavior, §A.6)
	else:
		logId = int(logId)
	bitTs = 1 if c.form_orderFileTimestamp else 0
	bitSn = 1 if c.form_siteNumberInOrder else 0
	audit = ("CONVERT(char(8),GETDATE(),112) "
	         "+ SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),1,2) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),4,2) "
	         "+ SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),7,2) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),10,2)")

	dataArgs = [code, name, s(c.form_address), s(c.form_city), s(c.form_state), s(c.form_zip),
	            s(c.form_country), s(c.form_tel), s(c.form_fax), s(c.form_person), s(c.form_email),
	            s(c.form_directory), logId, s(c.form_outputFile), bitTs, bitSn,
	            s(c.form_createOrderSheet), invAdd]

	try:
		if recId == 0:
			insSql = ("INSERT INTO INV_SUPPLIER_MST "
			          "(VC_SUPPLIER_CODE, VC_SUPPLIER_NAME, VC_ADDRESS, VC_CITY, VC_STATE, VC_ZIP, VC_COUNTRY, "
			          " VC_TEL, VC_FAX, VC_PERSON, VC_EMAIL_ADDRESS, VC_BREAKDOWN_ORDER_DIRECTORY, "
			          " IN_LOGISTICS_ID, VC_OUTPUT_FILE, BIT_ORDER_FILE_TIMESTAMP, BIT_SITE_NUMBER_IN_ORDER, "
			          " VC_CREATE_ORDER_SHEET, VC_INVENTORY_ADD_POINT, VC_ADD) "
			          "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?, " + audit + "); "
			          "SELECT CAST(SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS int) AS newId")
			rs = system.db.runPrepQuery(insSql, dataArgs, DB)
			newId = int(rs.getValueAt(0, 0))
			c.statusMsg = "Inserted supplier %s (id %d)." % (code, newId)
			log.info("SPIKE Supplier INSERT ok: code=%s newId=%d" % (code, newId))
			c.runNonce = (c.runNonce or 0) + 1   # refresh grid (same-view)
			c.recordId = newId                    # flip to edit mode -> fires onChange reload
		else:
			updSql = ("UPDATE INV_SUPPLIER_MST SET "
			          "VC_SUPPLIER_CODE=?, VC_SUPPLIER_NAME=?, VC_ADDRESS=?, VC_CITY=?, VC_STATE=?, VC_ZIP=?, "
			          "VC_COUNTRY=?, VC_TEL=?, VC_FAX=?, VC_PERSON=?, VC_EMAIL_ADDRESS=?, "
			          "VC_BREAKDOWN_ORDER_DIRECTORY=?, IN_LOGISTICS_ID=?, VC_OUTPUT_FILE=?, "
			          "BIT_ORDER_FILE_TIMESTAMP=?, BIT_SITE_NUMBER_IN_ORDER=?, VC_CREATE_ORDER_SHEET=?, "
			          "VC_INVENTORY_ADD_POINT=?, VC_LASTUPDATE = " + audit + " "
			          "WHERE IN_SUPPLIER_ID = ? "
			          "-- IG-SITE: AND site_id = ?")
			n = system.db.runPrepUpdate(updSql, dataArgs + [recId], DB)
			c.statusMsg = "Updated supplier %s (%d row)." % (code, n)
			log.info("SPIKE Supplier UPDATE ok: id=%d code=%s rows=%d" % (recId, code, n))
			c.runNonce = (c.runNonce or 0) + 1   # refresh grid (same-view)
	except Exception, e:
		msg = unicode(e)
		if "IX_INV_SUPPLIER_MST" in msg or "duplicate key" in msg.lower() or "UNIQUE" in msg.upper():
			c.statusMsg = "Supplier code already exists."
			log.info("SPIKE Supplier save: unique-index backstop fired for code=%s" % code)
		else:
			c.statusMsg = "Save failed: %s" % msg
			log.warn("SPIKE Supplier save FAILED: %s" % msg)

# ---- Supplier Delete — D3 RESTRICT gate (R1-critical), §B.5 (reused from Detail view) ----
	# refCount counts ALL THREE tables the live DELETE_SupplierCode trigger touches:
	#   parts (by IN_SUPPLIER_ID) + INV_BREAKDOWN_FC_INF + INV_FORECAST_INF (both by code).
	# Block on any non-zero total; NEVER let a delete reach the trigger while refs exist.
	# On success: reset to insert mode + refresh grid (same-view, no navigation).
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	c = self.view.custom
	recId = int(c.recordId or 0)
	code = (c.form_code or "").strip()
	if recId == 0:
		c.statusMsg = "Nothing to delete (unsaved new record)."
		return
	refSql = ("SELECT "
	          "  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INV_PARTS_STOCK_MST  WHERE IN_SUPPLIER_ID   = ?) "
	          "+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INV_BREAKDOWN_FC_INF WHERE VC_SUPPLIER_CODE = ?) "
	          "+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INV_FORECAST_INF     WHERE VC_SUPPLIER_CODE = ?) AS n")
	rs = system.db.runPrepQuery(refSql, [recId, code, code], DB)
	n = int(rs.getValueAt(0, 0))
	log.info("SPIKE Supplier refCount: id=%d code=%s n=%d" % (recId, code, n))
	if n > 0:
		c.statusMsg = ("Cannot delete supplier %s — still referenced by %d part(s) / forecast row(s). "
		               "Reassign or archive those rows first.") % (code, n)
		log.info("SPIKE Supplier DELETE BLOCKED: id=%d code=%s refs=%d" % (recId, code, n)); return
	try:
		delN = system.db.runPrepUpdate("DELETE FROM INV_SUPPLIER_MST WHERE IN_SUPPLIER_ID = ? -- IG-SITE: AND site_id = ?", [recId], DB)
		log.info("SPIKE Supplier DELETE ok: id=%d code=%s rows=%d" % (recId, code, delN))
		c.statusMsg = "Deleted supplier %s." % code
		c.form_code = ""; c.form_name = ""; c.form_address = ""; c.form_city = ""; c.form_state = ""
		c.form_zip = ""; c.form_country = ""; c.form_tel = ""; c.form_fax = ""; c.form_person = ""
		c.form_email = ""; c.form_directory = ""; c.form_logisticsId = None
		c.form_outputFile = "T"; c.form_orderFileTimestamp = False; c.form_siteNumberInOrder = False
		c.form_createOrderSheet = ""; c.form_invAddPoint = "S"
		c.runNonce = (c.runNonce or 0) + 1   # refresh grid (same-view)
		c.recordId = 0                        # back to insert mode
	except Exception, e:
		c.statusMsg = "Delete failed: %s" % unicode(e)
		log.warn("SPIKE Supplier DELETE FAILED: %s" % unicode(e))

# Clear -> reset to a blank insert-mode form (recordId=0). Same-view, no navigation.
	c = self.view.custom
	c.form_code = ""; c.form_name = ""; c.form_address = ""; c.form_city = ""; c.form_state = ""
	c.form_zip = ""; c.form_country = ""; c.form_tel = ""; c.form_fax = ""; c.form_person = ""
	c.form_email = ""; c.form_directory = ""; c.form_logisticsId = None
	c.form_outputFile = "T"; c.form_orderFileTimestamp = False; c.form_siteNumberInOrder = False
	c.form_createOrderSheet = ""; c.form_invAddPoint = "S"
	c.recordId = 0
	c.statusMsg = "Cleared — ready for a new supplier."
	system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").info("SPIKE Supplier form cleared")

# ---- Supplier combined onStartup — load FK combos for insert mode ----
	# The grid populates via the gridModel expr binding; the detail form populates via
	# the custom.recordId onChange when a row is clicked. At startup recordId=0 (insert
	# mode), so just preload the combos so the dropdowns are usable immediately.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	c = self.view.custom
	logDs = system.db.runPrepQuery("SELECT IN_LOGISTICS_ID AS id, VC_LOGISTICS_NAME AS label FROM INV_LOGISTICS_MST /* IG-SITE: WHERE site_id = ? */ ORDER BY VC_LOGISTICS_NAME", [], DB)
	c.logisticsOptions = [{"value": logDs.getValueAt(i, "id"), "label": logDs.getValueAt(i, "label")} for i in xrange(logDs.rowCount)]
	ptDs = system.db.runPrepQuery("SELECT VC_PART_TYPE AS id, VC_PART_TYPE AS label FROM INV_PART_TYPE_MST /* IG-SITE: WHERE site_id = ? */ ORDER BY VC_PART_TYPE", [], DB)
	c.partTypeOptions = [{"value": ptDs.getValueAt(i, "id"), "label": ptDs.getValueAt(i, "label")} for i in xrange(ptDs.rowCount)]
	c.statusMsg = "New supplier — enter details and Save, or click a row to edit."
	log.info("SPIKE Supplier combined onStartup: combos logistics=%d partType=%d" % (logDs.rowCount, ptDs.rowCount))
